notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Roadmap includes AI-native search and in-app triage for enterprise customers. Looking to replace a mix of OpenAI + self-hosted embeddings for cost predictability and SLA guarantees.

Engagement history / timeline (short):
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE Aisha) — prospect interested in Hosted API to validate prompts quickly.
- 2026-01-28: Demo (SE Marco) — showed streaming chat + embeddings throughput benchmarks. Customer asked about 99th pctl latency guarantees.
- 2026-02-10: Deep dive (product + infra) — reviewed Dedicated architecture and VPC options. Customer: "need predictable costs and control over keys".
- 2026-02-18: POC kickoff (Hosted API + small Dedicated trial) — 2-week evaluation; test dataset ~200k docs, peak ingestion 300 req/s.
- 2026-02-24: Pricing workshop (AE + SE + Finance) — proposed Dedicated commit tiers: 2xG4 pools / 4xA100 equiv. Customer countered with lower initial commit and higher burst allowance.
- 2026-02-28: Security questionnaire submitted. SOC2 docs uploaded to shared Drive.
- 2026-03-01: POC metrics reported back: embeddings upsert latency median 80ms, qps sustained 220, occasional 95th pctl spikes to 420ms on complex rerank flows.

POC notes / technical requirements:
- Workloads: user-facing doc search (embeddings + reranking), internal support agent (chat), periodic large-batch reranks for personalization.
- Targets: 95th pctl token latency <= 300ms for chat flows; embeddings upsert <150ms; sustained qps 200-300 for peak periods.
- Model preferences: open-models-first (Llama-family quantized) but willing to use Redwood-verified variants; fallback to smaller models for cost-sensitive routes.
- Routing needs: per-tenant routing; must be able to pin key enterprise customers to higher-SLA pool.
- Data residency: US-only tenant requirement for now.

Pricing / procurement specifics under negotiation:
- Proposed Dedicated commit tiers: Starter (6-month ramp) vs Standard (annual commit). Customer requests a hybrid: smaller initial commit (3 months) with scheduled ramp to full commit over 9 months.
- Burst: customer insists on 2.5x burst capacity for seasonal peaks (product launches). Redwood proposed burst + overage at tiered rates; customer pushing for capped overage spending.
- Overage: customer wants automatic throttling fallback to hosted API rate-limited tier before incurring overage charges; legal/finance want explicit overage caps in SOW.
- Credits / early termination: procurement wants one-time onboarding credit and pro-rated credits if early termination within first year.

Security / legal notes:
- SSO/SAML in place (Okta). KMS integration required; customer prefers comingled HSM for key separation.
- Need audit log export cadence (daily) and 1-year retention for audit events.
- Data processing addendum and DPA under final legal review.

Current status & next actions:
- Commercial: AE and Finance to finalize commit size and ramp schedule by 2026-03-10. Awaiting procurement confirmation on overage cap.
- Technical: SE to deliver final performance tuning playbook (batching + caching config) — in progress.
- Security: Security team to validate KMS integration plan; target sign-off 2026-03-12.

Quotes & call snippets:
- Product lead: "We need both predictable monthly spend and the ability to absorb spikes without breaking the product UX."
- Procurement: "If we can't get an overage cap we need to stick to Hosted only for now."

Open blockers (short):
- Procurement sign-off on ramp schedule and overage cap.
- Final KMS/HSM integration timeline.
- Legal on DPA + termination credit language.

- Provide clear quantization + batching recommendations (SE deliverable) and offer one onboarding performance tuning day as part of the SOW.
- Legal: draft one-off clause for overage cap for first year and pro-rated onboarding credit.
